last.verdict: Shares fell despite a profit beat, as job cuts and in-line revenue overshadowed the raised outlook.

reasons.label: Job cuts, restructuring
reasons.text: $336M restructuring charge to cut about 5% of jobs, raising cost and execution questions.

reasons.label: Revenue merely in line
reasons.text: Revenue rose 9% to $20.1B, with no standout upside to cheer.

reasons.label: Flattered profit, costs rising
reasons.text: EPS jumped 31%, but a sale gain helped; adjusted gain was 13%, marketing up 11%.

story: Amex has beaten profit targets all year while revenue growth held near 10%. Yet shares fell after the January report (about 3.7%) and again in July (4-6%) on costs, taxes and a slight revenue miss. Guidance for 2026 was raised in July and again now.
